chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: After Hollywood, Thelma Carpenter and returning to the Onyx
summary: She finished the Hollywood engagement, was perhaps replaced at the Onyx by Thelma Carpenter, and returned for a couple of months.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And after that came the films.

Yeah. Well, after I finished the engagement out in Hollywood there were negotiations for the movie. They hadn't decided yet, it was just an idea. And I came back to New York and I went back into the Onyx Club and I stayed there for, I guess, for a couple of months.
Okay, could I just interrupt to ask one thing?
I recall reading somewhere that Thelma Carpenter was your replacement at the Onyx when you went out to the west coast. Do you remember anything about that?
There is a possibility that she did but I don't know anything about it because when I was out in California I just got out of touch.

I stayed in the Onyx Club for a couple of months and by that time, as I mentioned before, I was under management to Columbia Artists, and they had a lot of different clubs out of town, vaudeville, engagements too, so I was, I was really ready to
